en: Color postcard view of a large Gothic church with a tall spire and red-tiled roof facing a spacious central square with formal flowerbeds, lawns and a prominent equestrian monument in the middle. Around the square stand ornate 19th–20th century buildings with domed roofs and a row of parked vintage cars, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century scene. The sky is clear and blue and the area is busy with pedestrians.
